messages:
marie: Customer reported their free-trial credits dropped from 10k -> 0 overnight. They say no interactive usage, only a nightly ingest job. Project: proj-39d2. Service account: ingest-runner-01. Can we triage?

josh: Which endpoint did the job hit? embeddings / rerank / completions?

marie: Looks like embeddings.rerank call (they pass rerank payload into embeddings client by accident). Worker logs attached from customer show repeated short requests.

siva: @josh tagging with logs I pulled from their upload:

```
2026-02-24T03:12:01Z INFO worker job:start id=job-914
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z INFO batch split_on_whitespace=true docs=7400 estimated_tokens=~1.8M
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z WARN single_request_size > max_batch -> chunking into 6200 requests
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z ERROR call failed status=429 msg="rate_limit" attempt=1
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z INFO retry attempt=2 backoff_ms=0
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z ERROR call failed status=429 attempt=2
2026-02-24T03:12:02Z INFO retry attempt=3 backoff_ms=0
... (repeats) ...
2026-02-24T03:12:10Z INFO completed requests=6200 tokens_consumed=4,892,000
```

marie: Note the backoff_ms=0 lines — seems worker retried immediately instead of exponential backoff.

josh: Hmm. Two things to check: 1) why split_on_whitespace=true exploded token counts (customer used an html dump so whitespace tokenization caused huge fragmentation), and 2) why retry backoff was zero for this service account. Could be an old runtime config pinned on Dedicated or an older agent.

billing-bot: Billing event: promo_free_trial id=trial-2026-01 applied=false target=service_account:ingest-runner-01 cost_reported=4892000 tokens.

marie: The billing event says applied=false — that matches customer claim that scheduled jobs didn't use trial credits. Any idea how credits are attributed to service accounts?

siva: We recently changed attribution so promo credits apply to root user only; service accounts require explicit 'allow_promo' flag. Migration script missed projects created before 2025-10. I can repro locally with their config.

josh: Can you paste the minimal repro steps? I'll work on a fix.

siva: Repro steps:
1) create project with old schema (pre-2025-10)
2) create service account ingest-runner-01 via infra CLI
3) schedule job using embeddings.rerank client with payload incorrectly labeled as "rerank"
4) worker uses split_on_whitespace true and batch_size unset -> default behaviour chunker produces N requests
5) send 429 from local rate-limiter -> worker retries with backoff disabled because AGENT_RETRY_STRATEGY env var set to "legacy" on that host

josh: Ok thanks. Immediate mitigation steps: 1) refund affected trial credits to proj-39d2 manually, 2) set the customer's scheduled job to use a fixed batch_size=256 and split_on_whitespace=false, 3) patch agent to respect backoff for legacy strategy and roll to hosts flagged legacy.

marie: I already issued a temporary refund for 5M tokens to the project and told customer we are investigating. Customer is happy with refund but wants a root cause + fix ETA.

josh: ETA for hotfix: 6–12 hrs for an agent-side patch and rolling restart. Billing team to apply promo flag to all service accounts for pre-2025-10 projects will take a couple days.

billing-bot: Action logged: refund txn=txn-88a7 amount=5,000,000 tokens status=completed by=marie

marie: I'll update customer: hotfix in ~8 hours, promo-attr migration scheduled, and we refunded 5M tokens. Will post postmortem link in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:

josh: Also adding a small server-side guard: reject >2000 chunks per job with a 400 + helpful msg so future broken configs don't blast the billing plane.

siva: Added to my PR queue, assigning to @josh for rollout.

ingest-worker: dev note: long-term fix: change default chunker to token-based rather than whitespace-based for html dumps.

marie: thanks all — closing for now, will re-open if customer sees more drain.
